knowledge:
- key_parameters: countsSE=The SummarizedExperiment object containing the count data ;; assayName=The character name of the assay in the SummarizedExperiment to filter ;; colDataName=The character name of the column in colData describing biological conditions ;; prop0=Minimal proportion of zeros among a condition to consider a feature lowly expressed (default is (max_replicates - 1)/max_replicates) ;; percentile=Percentile used on the max distribution of lowly expressed genes to determine the filtering threshold (default is 0.9 if replicates < 5) ;; propUpThresh=Proportion of counts required to be above the threshold in at least one condition to keep the feature (default is 0.9)
- alternatives: Arbitrary thresholding (the standard practice of choosing an arbitrary count threshold, which SeqGate replaces with a data-driven approach)
- when_to_use: Use before performing differential expression analysis or other statistical tests on RNA-Seq/transcriptomics count data to remove lowly expressed features and increase detection sensitivity.
- pitfalls: The input must be a SummarizedExperiment object with a numeric count assay and condition annotations in colData. If the calculated proportion of replicates (propUpThresh * replicates) is not an integer, it is rounded up to the next integer, which may strictly filter datasets with very few replicates.

workflows.name: seqgate_filtering
workflows.intent: Filter lowly expressed features from a transcriptomics count dataset using replicate-based thresholding.
workflows.stages: 1. Load the SeqGate package and prepare the SummarizedExperiment object from the count matrix and condition metadata ;; 2. Apply the SeqGate filtering method using applySeqGate with default parameters ;; 3. Extract the kept features and the applied threshold ;; 4. Optionally apply SeqGate with custom parameters (prop0, percentile, propUpThresh) to refine filtering
workflows.code:
library(SeqGate)
data(data_MiTF_1000genes)
cond<-c("A","A","B","B","A","B")
rowData <- DataFrame(row.names=rownames(data_MiTF_1000genes))
colData <- DataFrame(Conditions=cond)
counts_strub <- SummarizedExperiment(
                  assays=list(counts=data_MiTF_1000genes),
                  rowData=rowData,
                  colData=colData)
counts_strub <- applySeqGate(counts_strub,"counts","Conditions")
keptGenes <- assay(counts_strub[rowData(counts_strub)$onFilter == TRUE,])
metadata(counts_strub)$threshold
filteredOut <- assay(counts_strub[rowData(counts_strub)$onFilter == FALSE,])
counts_strub <- applySeqGate(counts_strub,"counts","Conditions",
             prop0=1/3,
             percentile=0.8,
             propUpThresh=0.5)
